environment.description: Same application deployed in 'prod-services' namespace. Cluster uses Cilium CNI with default-deny posture. A CiliumNetworkPolicy resource named 'app-egress-restrict' is applied with spec.egress containing a single toCIDR entry allowing 10.0.0.0/8 and a toCIDRSet with a cidrGroupRef to 'corporate-ranges' (which resolves to 172.16.0.0/12 and 10.0.0.0/8). The policy has an explicit toCIDRSet.except entry for 169.254.0.0/16 in the egress rules. DNS egress is allowed only to kube-dns on port 53. The pod also has an annotation 'io.cilium.proxy-visibility: <Egress/53/UDP/DNS>' for L7 DNS inspection. Note: the policy does NOT filter on L7 HTTP content or inspect query parameters.
